(1) Name of the discovery
Attentional Residue in Task-Switch Drag

(2) Deep explanation (what it is)
Attentional Residue is the phenomenon where, after switching tasks, a chunk of your attention stays stuck on the previous task instead of fully transferring to the new one.
It’s not just “thinking about something else.”
It’s a measurable, persistent cognitive drag that:

lowers accuracy on the new task

slows reaction time

reduces working memory available for new input
